description:
The process begins when a company identifies the need for a new supplier or vendor.
The procurement team issues a request for proposals (RFP) and receives responses from various suppliers.
Each proposal is evaluated based on criteria like cost, quality, and delivery time.
The team may also conduct site visits or interviews with suppliers.
After careful analysis, a supplier is selected, and contract negotiations begin.
Once both parties agree on the terms, the contract is signed.
The process ends when the supplier is officially onboarded, and the contract is executed.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_SupplierSelection"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/supplier-selection">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RFP" name="Request for proposals"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Proposal" name="Supplier proposal"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_SupplierSelection">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company" processRef="Process_SupplierSelection"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Proposal" name="Supplier proposals" sourceRef="Participant_Suppliers" targetRef="Task_ReceiveProposals" messageRef="Message_Proposal"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_SupplierSelection" name="Select and onboard supplier" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_NeedIdentified" name="Need for a new supplier identified"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_IssueRFP" name="Issue request for proposals" messageRef="Message_RFP"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveProposals" name="Receive supplier proposals" messageRef="Message_Proposal"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EvaluateProposals" name="Evaluate proposals"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalAssessment" name="Conduct additional assessment?" default="Flow_AssessmentNo"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConductAssessment" name="Conduct site visits or interviews with suppliers"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AssessmentMerge" name="Merge assessment paths"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectSupplier" name="Select supplier"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateTerms" name="Negotiate contract terms with supplier"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AgreeTerms" name="Agree contract terms"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SignContract" name="Sign contract"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CompletionSplit" name="Complete onboarding and contract execution"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OnboardSupplier" name="Onboard supplier"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ExecuteContract" name="Execute contract"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CompletionJoin" name="Onboarding and execution complete"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Complete" name="Supplier onboarded and contract executed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_NeedIdentified" targetRef="Task_IssueRFP"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_IssueRFP" targetRef="Task_ReceiveProposals"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveProposals" targetRef="Task_EvaluateProposals"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateProposals" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalAssessment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AssessmentYes" name="Assessment needed" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalAssessment" targetRef="Task_ConductAssessment">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">additionalAssessmentNeeded</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AssessmentNo" name="No additional assessment" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalAssessment" targetRef="Gateway_AssessmentMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AssessmentToMerge" sourceRef="Task_ConductAssessment" targetRef="Gateway_AssessmentMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Gateway_AssessmentMerge" targetRef="Task_SelectSupplier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_SelectSupplier" targetRef="Task_NegotiateTerms"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateTerms" targetRef="Task_AgreeTerms"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_AgreeTerms" targetRef="Task_SignContract"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Task_SignContract" targetRef="Gateway_CompletionSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Gateway_CompletionSplit" targetRef="Task_OnboardSupplier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Gateway_CompletionSplit" targetRef="Task_ExecuteContract"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_OnboardSupplier" targetRef="Gateway_CompletionJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_ExecuteContract" targetRef="Gateway_CompletionJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Gateway_CompletionJoin" targetRef="EndEvent_Complete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
